import pandas as pd
import sqlite3

# Load SME customer IDs from database
conn = sqlite3.connect('db/customers.db')
sme_customers = pd.read_sql_query("SELECT CustomerID FROM customers WHERE Segment = 'SME'", conn)
conn.close()
sme_ids = set(sme_customers['CustomerID'].tolist())
print(f"Loaded {len(sme_ids)} SME customer IDs")

# Load consumption data and filter
df = pd.read_csv('csv/yearmonth.csv')
print(f"Total rows in CSV: {len(df)}")

# Filter for SME customers and year 2013
df['Date'] = df['Date'].astype(str)
df_2013_sme = df[(df['CustomerID'].isin(sme_ids)) & (df['Date'].str.startswith('2013'))]
print(f"SME 2013 rows: {len(df_2013_sme)}")

# Calculate average monthly consumption
avg_consumption = df_2013_sme['Consumption'].mean()
print(f"Average monthly consumption: {avg_consumption}")
